mapper.insert: INSERT INTO history ( user_id, project_id, environment_id, site_id, method, url, response_code, response_time, logged_time, header, parameter, form_parameter, response_body, response_header) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{projectId}, #{environmentId}, #{siteId}, #{method}, #{url}, #{responseCode}, #{responseTime}, #{loggedTime}, #{header}, #{parameter}, #{formParameter}, #{responseBody}, #{responseHeader} );
mapper.select: SELECT h.id, h.method, h.url, h.response_code AS responseCode, h.response_time AS responseTime, h.logged_time AS loggedTime, h.header, h.parameter, h.form_parameter AS formParameter, h.response_body AS responseBody, h.response_header AS responseHeader, u.email AS requestUserEmail, p.name AS projectName, pu.email AS projectOwnerEmail, COALESCE(s.name, 'X') AS siteName, COALESCE(e.name, 'X') AS environmentName FROM history h LEFT JOIN users u ON h.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN project p ON h.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN users pu ON p.user_id = pu.id LEFT JOIN site s ON h.site_id = s.id LEFT JOIN environment e ON h.environment_id = e.id WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY h.logged_time DESC

SELECT h.id, h.method, h.url, h.response_code AS responseCode, h.response_time AS responseTime, h.logged_time AS loggedTime, h.header, h.parameter, h.form_parameter AS formParameter, h.response_body AS responseBody, h.response_header AS responseHeader, u.email AS requestUserEmail, p.name AS projectName, pu.email AS projectOwnerEmail, COALESCE(s.name, 'X') AS siteName, COALESCE(e.name, 'X') AS environmentName FROM history h LEFT JOIN users u ON h.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN project p ON h.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN users pu ON p.user_id = pu.id LEFT JOIN site s ON h.site_id = s.id LEFT JOIN environment e ON h.environment_id = e.id WHERE h.id = #{id} ORDER BY h.logged_time DESC

SELECT h.id, h.method, h.url, h.response_code AS responseCode, h.response_time AS responseTime, h.logged_time AS loggedTime, h.header, h.parameter, h.form_parameter AS formParameter, h.response_body AS responseBody, h.response_header AS responseHeader, u.email AS requestUserEmail, p.name AS projectName, pu.email AS projectOwnerEmail, COALESCE(s.name, 'X') AS siteName, COALESCE(e.name, 'X') AS environmentName FROM history h LEFT JOIN users u ON h.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN project p ON h.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN users pu ON p.user_id = pu.id LEFT JOIN site s ON h.site_id = s.id LEFT JOIN environment e ON h.environment_id = e.id WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} AND response_code >= 400 AND response_code < 600 AND logged_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} ORDER BY h.logged_time DESC

SELECT h.id, h.method, h.url, h.response_code AS responseCode, h.response_time AS responseTime, h.logged_time AS loggedTime, h.header, h.parameter, h.form_parameter AS formParameter, h.response_body AS responseBody, h.response_header AS responseHeader, u.email AS requestUserEmail, p.name AS projectName, pu.email AS projectOwnerEmail, COALESCE(s.name, 'X') AS siteName, COALESCE(e.name, 'X') AS environmentName FROM history h LEFT JOIN users u ON h.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN project p ON h.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN users pu ON p.user_id = pu.id LEFT JOIN site s ON h.site_id = s.id LEFT JOIN environment e ON h.environment_id = e.id WHERE h.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY h.logged_time DESC
